facts.text: The hotel is on a private street in downtown Milan, between Via Montenapoleone, Via della Spiga, La Scala and the Accademia di Brera.
facts.excerpt: On a private street in downtown Milan, between Via Montenapoleone, Via della Spiga, La Scala and the Accademia di Brera

facts.text: The hotel occupies a renovated 18th-century Milanese palazzo.
facts.excerpt: in a tastefully renovated 18th-century Milanese palazzo is The Bvlgari Hotel Milano, a five star hotel

facts.text: The hotel has a 4,000-square-meter private garden, described as a natural extension of the nearby Botanical Garden.
facts.excerpt: 4,000-square-meter private garden, a natural extension of the nearby Botanical Garden

facts.text: The earliest mention of the original layout of the hotel garden is in the Ruralium Commodorum by Piero de Crescenza, from 1305.
facts.excerpt: The earliest mention of the original layout of the Bvlgari Hotel garden is found in the Ruralium Commodorum by Piero de Crescenza, from 1305.

facts.text: The lounge fireplace is made of black Zimbabwe granite and weighs 15 tonnes.
facts.excerpt: The fireplace in the lounge, made of black Zimbabwe granite, weighs 15 tonnes.

facts.text: Guests can visit the adjacent Botanical Garden inside the Palazzo di Brera, which also hosts the Pinacoteca.
facts.excerpt: One can visit the adjacent Botanical Garden inside the enormous Palazzo di Brera, which also hosts the Pinacoteca.

facts.text: The hotel organizes private visits to villas and museums, hydroplane trips around Lake Como and excursions to Italian destinations by private plane, limousine or yacht.
facts.excerpt: organizes private visits to villas and museums, hydroplane trips around Lake Como and excursions to Italy’s most exclusive destinations by private plane, limousine or yacht

facts.text: Services include a personal shopper, personal trainer, luxury car rental, in-room check-in, assistance with packing and unpacking, and a parking garage.
facts.excerpt: Other services include a personal shopper, personal trainer, luxury car rental, in-room check-in, assistance with packing and unpacking, and a parking garage.

facts.text: Premium Rooms face either the garden or a Milanese courtyard.
facts.excerpt: face both onto our famous garden or charming Milanese courtyard

facts.text: Premium Suites are on private floors with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the adjoining Botanical Gardens.
facts.excerpt: Located on private floors, the Premium Suites are luxurious with floor to ceiling windows overlooking the adjoining Botanical Gardens.

facts.text: The Bvlgari Suite is a 160 sqm one-bedroom suite with a design curated by architect Flaviano Capriotti.
facts.excerpt: the 160 sqm one-bedroom Bvlgari Suite is a quiet haven of pure luxury. A thoughtful expression of timeless contemporary design curated by architect Flaviano Capriotti
